wrawl.definition: To cry, as a cat; to waul.

wreak.example: She wreaked her anger on his car.
wreak.definition: To cause something harmful; to afflict; to inflict; to harm or injury; to let out something harmful; .

wreck.example: He was an emotional wreck after the death of his wife.
wreck.definition: Something or someone that has been ruined.

wrens.definition: Any member of a mainly New World passerine bird family Troglodytidae; true wren.

wrest.definition: The act of wresting; a wrench or twist; distortion.

wrier.definition: Turned away, contorted (of the face or body).

wring.example: I grasped his hand and gave it a grateful wring.
wring.definition: A powerful squeezing or twisting action.

wrist.definition: The complex joint between forearm bones, carpus, and metacarpals where the hand is attached to the arm; the carpus in a narrow sense.

write.definition: The act or style of writing.

writs.definition: A written order, issued by a court, ordering someone to do (or stop doing) something.

wrong.definition: Something that is immoral or not good.

wrote.example: The pupil wrote his name on the paper.
wrote.definition: To form letters, words or symbols on a surface in order to communicate.

wrung.example: I didn’t have a towel so I just wrung my hair dry.
wrung.definition: To squeeze or twist (something) tightly so that liquid is forced out. See also wring out.

wryer.definition: Turned away, contorted (of the face or body).

wryly.example: 1966: The sins of the father, she thought wryly. Well, they had visited Tony, all right — only he didn't know it. — Jacqueline Susann, Valley of the Dolls (Grove Press 1997, p. 206)

wuxia.definition: A genre of Chinese fiction concerning the adventures of martial artists, typically set in Ancient China.

wynds.definition: A narrow lane, alley or path, especially one between houses.

wynns.definition: A letter of the Old English alphabet, borrowed from the futhark and used to represent the sound of w; replaced in Middle English times by the digraph uu, which later developed into the letter w.

xebec.definition: A small two-masted, and later three-masted, Mediterranean transport ship with an overhanging bow and stern.

xenon.definition: The chemical element (symbol Xe) with an atomic number of 54. It is a colorless, odorless, unreactive noble gas, used notably in camera flash technology.

xeric.definition: Extremely dry, lacking humidity and water.

xerox.example: Hand me that xerox, would you?

xoana.definition: A wooden statue used as a cult image in Ancient Greece.

xylem.definition: A vascular tissue in land plants primarily responsible for the distribution of water and minerals taken up by the roots; also the primary component of wood.

xylic.definition: Pertaining to, derived from, or related to, xylene; specifically, designating any one of several metameric acids produced by the partial oxidation of mesitylene and pseudo-cumene.

xylyl.definition: Any one of three metameric radicals which are characteristic respectively of the three xylenes.

xysti.definition: (in Ancient Greece) A long and open portico within the gymnasium.

yabby.definition: A freshwater Australian crayfish of the genus Cherax, especially Cherax destructor.

yacca.definition: A West Indian name for two large timber trees (Podocarpus coriaceus, and P. Purdicanus) of the Yew family. The wood, which is much used, is pale brownish with darker streaks.

yacht.example: Would you like to go sailing on my uncle’s yacht?
yacht.definition: A slick and light ship for making pleasure trips or racing on water, having sails but often motor-powered. At times used as a residence offshore on a dock.

yager.definition: In the German army, one belonging to a body of light infantry armed with rifles, resembling the chasseur of the French army.

yahoo.definition: A rough, coarse, loud or uncouth person; yokel; lout.

yales.definition: A mythical beast in European mythology and heraldry, usually portrayed as an antelope- or goat-like four-legged creature with large horns that it can swivel in any direction.

yampy.definition: A vegetable, the Indian white yam.

yanks.definition: A sudden, vigorous pull (sometimes defined as mass times jerk, or rate of change of force).

yappy.definition: Of a dog, yapping in an annoying manner.

yards.definition: A small, usually uncultivated area adjoining or (now especially) within the precincts of a house or other building.

yarns.definition: A twisted strand of fiber used for knitting or weaving.

yawed.definition: To turn about the vertical axis while maintaining course.

yawls.definition: A small ship's boat, usually rowed by four or six oars.

yawns.definition: The action of yawning; opening the mouth widely and taking a long, rather deep breath, often because one is tired or bored.

yeans.definition: (of goats or sheep) To give birth to.

yearn.example: All I yearn for is a simple life.
yearn.definition: To long, have a strong desire (for something).

years.example: we moved to this town a year ago;  I quit smoking exactly one year ago

yeast.definition: An often humid, yellowish froth produced by fermenting malt worts, and used to brew beer, leaven bread, and also used in certain medicines.

yeggs.example: 1904, Edwin S. Porter (director), Capture of the ‘Yegg’ Bank Burglars
yeggs.definition: A person who breaks open safes; a burglar.

yelps.example: The puppy let out a yelp when I stepped on her tail.
yelps.definition: An abrupt, high-pitched noise or utterance.

yenta.example: Please don't tell your girlfriend what I said; she's a yenta!
yenta.definition: A woman who meddles in the business of others; a busybody; a female gossipmonger.

yerba.definition: Ilex paraguariensis, a species of holly native to southern South America; or the dried leaves and twigs of this plant, used to make the caffeine-rich beverage mate.

yeses.definition: An affirmative expression; an answer that shows agreement or acceptance.

yetis.definition: An unidentified humanoid animal said to live in the Himalayas

yewen.definition: Made of yew; as, yewen bows.

yield.definition: To pay, give in payment; repay, recompense; reward; requite.

yikes.example: Then she told me I was ‘beautiful, for a black girl’. —Yikes!

yipes.example: Then she told me I was ‘beautiful, for a black girl’. —Yikes!

yocks.definition: A laugh, especially a loud or hearty one.

yodle.definition: To sing in a manner common among the Swiss and Tyrolese mountaineers, by suddenly changing from the head voice, or falsetto, to the chest voice, and the contrary; to warble.

yoghs.definition: A letter of the Middle English alphabet (capital Ȝ, small ȝ), in form derived from the Old English shape of the letter g, and used to represent various palatal and velar sounds.

yogis.example: Gurdjieff connects this type of breathing with yogi breathing.
yogis.definition: A devotee or adherent of yoga.

yojan.definition: A measure of distance, varying from four to ten miles, but usually about five.

yokes.definition: Frame around the neck, and related senses.

yolks.definition: The yellow, spherical part of an egg that is surrounded by the white albumen, and serves as nutriment for the growing young.

yomps.definition: A long-distance march carrying full kit.

yonis.definition: The vulva or vagina, or a symbol of them, especially as an object of veneration within certain types of Hinduism, Buddhism, and other cultures.

yonks.definition: A long time (especially a longer time than expected); ages

yorks.definition: To bowl a yorker at a batsman, especially to get a batsman out in this way.

young.example: The young of today are well-educated.
young.definition: People who are young; young people, collectively; youth.

yourn.definition: (obsolete outside Britain and United States dialectal) Yours.

yours.example: If this edit is mine, the other must be yours.  Their encyclopedia is good, but yours is even better.  It’s all yours.
yours.definition: That which belongs to you (singular); the possessive second-person singular pronoun used without a following noun.

youth.example: Her youth and beauty attracted him to her.
youth.definition: The quality or state of being young.

yowls.definition: A prolonged, loud cry, like the sound of an animal; a wail; a howl.

yucca.definition: Any of several evergreen plants of the genus Yucca, having long, pointed, and rigid leaves at the top of a woody stem, and bearing a large panicle of showy white blossoms.

yucky.definition: Of something highly offensive; causing aversion or disgust.

yugas.definition: In Hindu theology, an epoch or era within a cycle of four ages: the Satya Yuga (or Krita Yuga), the Dvapara Yuga, the Treta Yuga and finally the Kali Yuga, with lengths ranging from 432,000 to 1,728,000 years.

yukky.definition: Of something highly offensive; causing aversion or disgust.

yulan.definition: Magnolia denudata, a species of magnolia with large white blossoms that open before the leaves.

yuppy.definition: A young upwardly mobile urban professional person with an affluent lifestyle.

yurts.definition: A large, round, semi-permanent tent with vertical walls and a conical roof, usually associated with Central Asia and Mongolia (where it is known as a ger).

yuzus.definition: A citrus fruit originating in East Asia, Citrus ichangensis x Citrus reticulata var. austera.

zaire.definition: The unit of currency of Zaire.

zakat.definition: Almsgiving, one of the five pillars of Islam.

zambo.definition: The child of a mulatto and a negro; also, the child of an Indian and a negro; colloquially or humorously, a negro; a sambo.

zamia.definition: Any of various cycads of the genera Zamia and Macrozamia

zaxes.definition: A tool, similar to a hatchet, used to prepare slate for roofing.

zayin.definition: The seventh letter of many Semitic alphabets (Phoenician, Aramaic, Hebrew, Syriac, Arabic and others).

zazen.definition: A form of seated meditation in Zen Buddhism.

zebec.definition: A small two-masted, and later three-masted, Mediterranean transport ship with an overhanging bow and stern.

zebra.definition: Any of three species of genus Equus: E. grevyi, E. quagga, or E. zebra, all with black and white stripes and native to Africa.

zebub.definition: A large noxious fly of Abyssinia, which like the tsetse fly, is destructive to cattle.

zebus.definition: A domesticated ox native to Asia and Africa, having a large fleshy hump on its back and a dewlap (Bos primigenius indicus).

zeros.example: In unary and k-adic notation in general, zero is the empty string.

zests.example: The orange zest gives the strong flavor in this dish.
zests.definition: The outer skin of a citrus fruit, used as a flavouring or garnish.

zetas.definition: The sixth letter of the modern Greek alphabet (Ζ, ζ) preceded by epsilon (Ε, ε) and followed by eta, (Η, η); or the seventh letter in the ancient Greek alphabet, in which it is preceded by digamma (Ϝ, ϝ)

zilch.definition: A nobody: a person who is worthless in importance or character.

zilla.definition: A low, thorny, suffrutescent, crucifeous plant (Zilla myagroides) found in the deserts of Egypt. Its leaves are boiled in water, and eaten, by the Arabs.

zinco.definition: A line or half-tone block etched on zinc plate, used in zincography.

zincs.definition: A chemical element (symbol Zn) with an atomic number of 30, a slightly brittle blue-silvery metal.

zineb.definition: An organic fungicide and insecticide sprayed on cereal grasses, fruit trees, etc.

zines.definition: A low-circulation, non-commercial publication of original or appropriated texts and images, especially one of minority interest.

zings.definition: A short high-pitched humming sound, such as that made by a bullet or vibrating string.

zoned.example: Please zone off our staging area, a section for each group.

zooid.definition: An organic body or cell having locomotion, as a spermatic cell or spermatozoid.

zooms.definition: To communicate with someone using the Zoom videoconferencing software.

zoris.definition: A Japanese sandal made from rice straw or lacquered wood, worn with a kimono for formal occasions.

zowie.definition: An indication of astonishment or admiration.

zymic.definition: Pertaining to, or produced by, fermentation; -- formerly, by confusion, used to designate lactic acid.
